sources.title: OpenAI API changelog: November 20, 2024
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through the official documentation fetch tool. The dated November 20, 2024 entry releases gpt-4o-2024-11-20 as the newest GPT-4o-series model, but supplies no nominal total or active count and no named counted base-model lineage.

sources.title: GPT-4o model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through the official documentation fetch tool and full Markdown cached at /tmp/openai-frontspec-cache/06.txt (HTTP 200, fetched 16:22 UTC). Lists the November snapshot under GPT-4o; the undated alias defaults to August 6. The full model specification has no total or active parameter count. Deprecation and snapshot-specific non-parameter findings from the original audit are retained.

sources.title: Foundry Models sold by Azure: GPT-4o capabilities
sources.evidence: The exact gpt-4o (2024-11-20) row specifies 128,000 input/context tokens, 16,384 maximum output, text and image processing, structured outputs and parallel function calling. The page also explicitly lists this version as supporting Responses and Chat Completions. Provider availability dates are not used as original release dates.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API: comparison appendix
sources.evidence: Reopened the full original OpenAI article October 27, 2026. The comparison appendix names GPT-4o (2024-11-20) exactly and reports academic, coding, vision, long-context and function-calling scores, but contains no model parameter count or activated-parameter comparison. GPT-4.1 specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Reasoning best practices
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown read. Explicitly distinguishes non-reasoning GPT models from o-series reasoning models and names undated GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini as examples. It does not explicitly identify November 20 or all dated snapshots; checked as a behavioral-classification lead, not exact-snapshot proof.

sources.title: API deprecations: GPT-4 series models
sources.evidence: October 14, 2026 notice explicitly schedules gpt-4o-2024-11-20 for January 14, 2027 removal from the OpenAI API. This is a future shutdown at review time, distinct from May-snapshot shutdown and ChatGPT retirement.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current terms effective January 1, 2026 govern API services and reserve service intellectual-property rights under section 9.1. Used for descriptive proprietary classification, not a claim that these exact terms governed the November 2024 launch.

sources.title: Introducing gpt-oss
sources.evidence: August 5, 2025 first-party article calls gpt-oss the first open-weight language models since GPT-2 and describes GPT-4o as proprietary. Canonical direct request timed out; indexed primary text and the same page with a query parameter were readable. Counts for gpt-oss are not transferred.

sources.title: Toward understanding and preventing misalignment generalization
sources.evidence: Re-read the original full PDF text freshly fetched October 27, 2026 at /tmp/openai-parameter-primary-cache/12.txt (HTTP 200). Appendix G.3 explicitly identifies gpt-4o-2024-08-06 as the full-fine-tuning release, not November. Section 3.1 and Appendix D describe 2.1 million auxiliary SAE latents; these are not a production-model total or active parameter count. No November count or counted named-base lineage is established.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown read. Explains Transformer attention caching and names the undated gpt-4o in its pricing examples, but does not identify the November 2024 snapshot. Checked as an architecture lead; no exact-version structure or parameter count is established.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown retrieved. For vision-capable models including GPT-4o, Responses PDF input is processed into extracted text and page images. Read with exact November vision/Responses support; PDF is an API input format, not a separate native sensory modality.

sources.title: Create a model response
sources.evidence: Full Markdown retrieved. The supported model enumeration includes gpt-4o-2024-11-20. This corroborates exact OpenAI Responses support alongside the API file-input processing rule; no live model request was made.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 12
sources.evidence: Reopened original research HTML October 27, 2026. Table 12 identifies GPT-4o-2024-11-20 exactly and explicitly prints a dash in both the # Activated Params and # Total Params rows, while giving numeric counts for the open-model comparators. This later model-team comparison supplies no nominal count for the target; its other models' counts cannot be transferred.

sources.title: Reasoning through Exploration: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Function Calling, Table 1
sources.publisher: Bingguang Hao et al. / AWorld Team, Inclusion AI and collaborators
sources.evidence: Reopened the original October 10, 2025 revision on October 27, 2026. Table 1 gives GPT-4o-2024-11-20 a slash in the Parameter Counts column, unlike numeric counts for open models. It reports no separate active count. This is original benchmarking evidence of an unreported comparison count, not an OpenAI disclosure or a proof that no disclosure could exist elsewhere.

name.note: Display name retains the exact dated snapshot, distinct from the August default alias and other GPT-4o releases.

developer.note: OpenAI publishes the exact snapshot release and subsequent evaluations.

family.note: The release explicitly belongs to the GPT-4o series; replace generic GPT.

release_date.note: Explicit dated developer changelog entry for the API release. Later Azure listings, evaluations and retirement notices do not replace it.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary API release; the later first-open-weights-since-GPT-2 statement corroborates closed weights.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-snapshot documentation and later original comparisons establish no nominal total count or counted named-base lineage. Qwen3 Table 12 prints a dash for total parameters; EGPO Table 1 also leaves the count unreported. Sibling counts, auxiliary SAE features and black-box estimates are not production specifications.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently of total size. Qwen3 Table 12 explicitly leaves # Activated Params blank for the exact November snapshot; the checked OpenAI sources and later EGPO comparison provide no active count. No dense-equals-total assumption or sibling convention is applied.

architecture.note: Exact-version architecture and training searches found no directly bound structure. The interpretability study uses August and caching discussion names the undated alias; neither establishes November structure. Retain null rather than transfer dense/MoE or broad Transformer claims.

context_window.note: Exact November provider row verifies 128,000 tokens, corroborated by exact-version long-context evaluations. Its separate 16,384 maximum output is not the context window.

modalities.note: Exact November text/image support and OpenAI Responses enumeration combine with the documented PDF processing rule. PDF denotes extracted text plus page images under the catalog API-format convention. Audio/realtime and image-generation variants are separate.

reasoning.note: The guide classifies the undated GPT-4o name among non-reasoning GPT models, but does not explicitly bind this claim to every dated snapshot or to November 20. The current undated alias maps to August. Clear the baseline false rather than treat family membership or missing reasoning fields as exact-version proof.

tool_call.note: Exact November provider table lists parallel function calling; later OpenAI comparison evaluates this same dated snapshot on function-calling benchmarks.

patch.notes: This is the fixed November 20, 2024 API snapshot; the undated alias defaults to August 6. Scheduled API shutdown is January 14, 2027; no live endpoint test was performed. PDF inputs are processed as extracted text and page images. Exact-snapshot dedicated reasoning support and architecture remain unverified. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed: the Qwen3 comparison explicitly leaves both unreported for this snapshot.

summary: Parameter re-audit on October 27 retained null total and active counts after reopening OpenAI model documentation, the exact GPT-4.1 comparison appendix and the interpretability paper, plus fresh searches for total and activated counts. Qwen3 Table 12 leaves both exact-November counts unreported; the later EGPO Table 1 likewise reports no count. No supported nominal specification or counted lineage was found. Preserved the other 12 field assessments.
